projects.title: Room of the Palhacito
projects.description: A whimsical little world where fantasy, color, and creativity come together. ==Room of the Palhacito== is a stylized 3D diorama that explores a playful and cozy atmosphere, blending circus-inspired elements, cartoon-like shapes, and charming details.  Through vibrant colors, expressive textures, and soft lighting, the scene captures a sense of wonder and imagination, bringing a unique and personality-filled environment to life.

projects.title: The Haunted Catch
projects.description: A spooky little hammerhead shark based on a concept by Oscar Ibanez. I had a lot of fun bringing this character into 3D and playing around with its shapes, expressions, and Halloween-inspired details.
